descriptions.blueprints_add-apps: Add apps to a Blueprint. Required: id (Blueprint ID), data=[{"type":"apps","id":"<app ID>"}]. Returns 204 with no body. Use apps_list to find IDs and blueprints_list-apps to see current members.
descriptions.blueprints_add-configurations: Add Configurations to a Blueprint. Required: id (Blueprint ID), data=[{"type":"configurations","id":"<ID>"}]. Returns 204 with no body. Use configurations_list to find IDs and blueprints_list-configurations to see current members.
descriptions.blueprints_add-devices: Add devices to a Blueprint. Required: id (Blueprint ID), data=[{"type":"orgDevices","id":"<serial>"}]. Returns 204 with no body. Use devices_list to find IDs and blueprints_list-devices to see current members.
descriptions.blueprints_add-packages: Add packages to a Blueprint. Required: id (Blueprint ID), data=[{"type":"packages","id":"<package ID>"}]. Returns 204 with no body. Use packages_list to find IDs and blueprints_list-packages to see current members.
descriptions.blueprints_add-user-groups: Add user groups to a Blueprint. Required: id (Blueprint ID), data=[{"type":"userGroups","id":"<group ID>"}]. Returns 204 with no body. Use user_groups_list to find IDs and blueprints_list-user-groups to see current members.
descriptions.blueprints_add-users: Add users to a Blueprint. Required: id (Blueprint ID), data=[{"type":"users","id":"<user ID>"}]. Returns 204 with no body. Use users_list to find IDs and blueprints_list-users to see current members.
descriptions.blueprints_create: Create a Blueprint in an organization. Pass the JSON:API body as params: {"data":{"type":"blueprints","attributes":{"name":"<name>","description":"<optional>"},"relationships":{"orgDevices":{"data":[{"type":"orgDevices","id":"<serial>"}]}}}}. relationships is optional and also takes apps, configurations, packages, users and userGroups, each {"data":[{"type":"<type>","id":"<ID>"}]}. Returns the new Blueprint (id, name, status, timestamps).
descriptions.blueprints_get: Get one Blueprint in an organization by ID. Required: id. Optional: include (apps, configurations, packages, orgDevices, users, userGroups) with matching limit_* caps, and fields_blueprints. Returns the Blueprint (name, status, appLicenseDeficient, timestamps) with its relationship linkages. Use blueprints_list when you do not have an ID.
descriptions.blueprints_remove-apps: Remove apps from a Blueprint. Required: id (Blueprint ID), data=[{"type":"apps","id":"<app ID>"}]. Returns 204 with no body. Destructive: changes what this Blueprint delivers; check blueprints_list-apps first.
descriptions.blueprints_remove-configurations: Remove Configurations from a Blueprint. Required: id (Blueprint ID), data=[{"type":"configurations","id":"<ID>"}]. Returns 204 with no body. Destructive: changes what this Blueprint delivers; check blueprints_list-configurations first.
descriptions.blueprints_remove-devices: Remove devices from a Blueprint. Required: id (Blueprint ID), data=[{"type":"orgDevices","id":"<serial>"}]. Returns 204 with no body. Destructive: changes what this Blueprint delivers; check blueprints_list-devices first.
descriptions.blueprints_remove-packages: Remove packages from a Blueprint. Required: id (Blueprint ID), data=[{"type":"packages","id":"<package ID>"}]. Returns 204 with no body. Destructive: changes what this Blueprint delivers; check blueprints_list-packages first.
descriptions.blueprints_remove-user-groups: Remove user groups from a Blueprint. Required: id (Blueprint ID), data=[{"type":"userGroups","id":"<group ID>"}]. Returns 204 with no body. Destructive: changes what this Blueprint delivers; check blueprints_list-user-groups first.
descriptions.blueprints_remove-users: Remove users from a Blueprint. Required: id (Blueprint ID), data=[{"type":"users","id":"<user ID>"}]. Returns 204 with no body. Destructive: changes what this Blueprint delivers; check blueprints_list-users first.
descriptions.blueprints_update: Update a Blueprint. Params: id (the Blueprint ID) plus {"data":{"type":"blueprints","id":"<same ID>","attributes":{"name":"...","description":"..."},"relationships":{...}}}; attributes and relationships are optional (relationships as in blueprints_create). Returns the updated Blueprint. To add or remove single members, prefer blueprints_add-* and blueprints_remove-*.
descriptions.devices_assigned-server: Get the device management service (MDM server) a device is assigned to. Required: id (the device serial number). Optional: fields_mdmServers. Returns the MDM server record (serverName, serverType, status). Use devices_assigned-server-id when you only need the server ID.
descriptions.mdm_servers_create: Create a device management service (MDM server) in an organization. Pass the JSON:API body as params: {"data":{"type":"mdmServers","attributes":{"serverName":"<name>","serverCertificate":{"name":"<file name>","data":"<base64 X.509 certificate>"}}}}; optional attributes.enableMdmDisownFlag (boolean). Returns the new MDM server with its id.
descriptions.mdm_servers_get: Get one device management service (MDM server) in an organization by ID. Required: id. Optional: fields_mdmServers. Returns the MDM server (serverName, serverType, status, deviceCount, defaultProductFamilies, lastConnectedDateTime). Use mdm_servers_list to find IDs and mdm_servers_devices for the serials assigned to it.
descriptions.mdm_servers_update: Update a device management service (MDM server). Params: id (the server ID) plus {"data":{"type":"mdmServers","id":"<same ID>","attributes":{...}}}. Every attribute is optional: serverName, defaultProductFamilies (e.g. ["MAC","IPHONE","IPAD"]), enableMdmDisownFlag, serverCertificate {"name","data"}. Returns the updated MDM server.
